name: Can I install under cabinet lighting myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install under cabinet lighting myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some basic plug-and-play under cabinet lighting kits can be installed by a homeowner, professional installation is recommended for most permanent solutions, especially if new electrical wiring or hardwiring is involved. A professional ensures proper wiring, adherence to safety codes, and a clean, integrated finish. This is particularly important for avoiding electrical hazards and ensuring the longevity and optimal performance of your lighting system. Our team handles all aspects of design and installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: For permanent or hardwired solutions, professional installation is recommended to ensure safety, proper wiring, and a clean finish.
